_about: The public photo gallery at /gallery (public/gallery.html). Built by scripts/gen-gallery.mjs. Mumbai photos: "site" reuses public/img/mumbai-2026/<site>.webp; "pid" is the photo store id (R2 event-photos/1/<pid>/m.jpg, fetched to the sources folder). Data Science Congress 2017 photos: "file" is the original in Downloads/Bharat AI/Pics. kind: stage, panel, hall, expo, people, arrivals.
_hero: The header photos, in order: they change every 7 seconds. ref is a photo in mumbai2026 (site or slug) or dsc2017 (slug); its caption is shown. pos is where to centre the photo when a phone crops it (x% y%). Only grand, full photos here.
